# AuthCore

> Self-hosted, security-first authentication for Node.js: register/login, JWT with rotating refresh tokens, email verification, password reset, invitations, magic links, OAuth and TOTP 2FA. One framework-agnostic core with adapters for Express, Fastify, NestJS and Next.js, a React SDK, and Prisma/Drizzle database adapters. MIT licensed.

Key facts for agents: install a framework adapter (e.g. @authcore/express) plus a database adapter (@authcore/prisma-adapter or @authcore/drizzle-adapter); mount the provided router/handler instead of writing auth routes; read AUTH_SECRET (>=32 chars) from the environment. Scaffold a working app with `npx create-authcore-app`. Every package ships an AGENTS.md with canonical usage.

Full documentation in one file: https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/llms-full.txt

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/getting-started)
- [Configuration](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/configuration)
- [Using AuthCore with AI coding assistants](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/ai-assistants): Use AuthCore with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other AI coding assistants: llms.txt, AGENTS.md shipped in every package, a ready-made prompt and a Claude skill.
- [AuthCore vs. other auth options](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/compare): How AuthCore compares to Better Auth, Auth.js, Passport and hosted auth (Clerk, Auth0). When to choose it and when not to.

## Recipes

- [Express: registration, email verification and password reset](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/recipes/express-email-verification-password-reset): Add registration, login, email verification and password reset to an Express + Prisma app with AuthCore, in under 10 minutes.
- [Next.js + Drizzle: auth in the App Router](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/recipes/nextjs-drizzle-auth): Add authentication to a Next.js App Router app with Drizzle ORM and AuthCore: one route handler, getCurrentUser() in Server Components, and middleware.
- [Role-based access control (admin-only routes)](https://david-ouatedem.github.io/auth-core/recipes/rbac-admin-routes): Restrict routes to admins with AuthCore role-based access control in Express, Fastify, NestJS and Next.js.
